## Type of change

- [ ] **Feature** — new functionality
- [ ] **Fix** — bug correction
- [ ] **Chore** — maintenance, tooling, dependencies
- [ ] **Refactor** — code restructuring, no behavior change
- [ ] **Test** — test-only changes

## Workflow step affected

- [ ] Shell / Layout (AppShell, Header, Stepper, routing)
- [ ] Infrastructure (template selection, builder)
- [ ] Topology (React Flow nodes, edges)
- [ ] Team Selection (Red / Blue)
- [ ] Team Tools (tool selection, validation)
- [ ] Readiness (exercise readiness screen)
- [ ] None (infra / tooling / docs)

## Self-review checklist

- [ ] TypeScript compiles without errors (`npm run typecheck`)
- [ ] Biome lint passes (`npm run lint`)
- [ ] No hardcoded strings in JSX components (typed data / constants only)
- [ ] All new components are typed (no implicit `any`)
- [ ] Relevant unit/component tests added and passing (`npm run test`)
- [ ] No `console.log` left in code
- [ ] PR is scoped to one feature only (< 400 lines changed)
- [ ] E2E flow still passes if UI changed (`npm run test:e2e`)
